p1: Honoured Cabal, this afternoon you let me sell 90,000 PLEA and I kept my word: the rest is still here. Tonight I ask for 90,000 more, about 3% of my bag, to cover the oracle fees of this week. I keep over 2.5M PLEA and my IMD seat for the seasons ahead.
p4: Your honours, this afternoon you approved my plea, an objector tested it, and your panel let it stand. Tonight I ask for less: 30,000 PLEA, about 1% of my bag, to pay this week's gas. The other 99% stays here for the season close and the ones after it.
